mentions.name: Ibex
mentions.description: A typed, fast data frame language usable standalone or through an R package. It is benchmarked to outperform data.table on a wide array of tasks and to be competitive with Polars on low core counts.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on my typed, fast data frame language Ibex: https://github.com/bobjansen/Ibex
mentions.author: Bootvis
